answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake and register a public key before trading. Spinning up thousands of fake identities then costs real capital, and any identity caught cheating forfeits its deposit. Peers verify each other through a shared cipher protocol, so credentials are checked cryptographically instead of trusted blindly. A violet marker on the reputation ledger flags clusters of fresh, linked identities for extra scrutiny, and the ledger works like a quill writing in permanent ink: every transaction is recorded, so a Sybil farmer's pattern stays visible.
